correctness.rationale: The nodal Gram matrix and its exact inverse row imply an explicit cyclic reproducing kernel. Opposite signs on each edge yield four exact integrals and the rational expression. The vertex-to-edge convexity argument proves global norm equality; 221 exact checker cases corroborate the algebra.

value.rationale: Four arcs form the smallest nontrivial closed two-periodic spline mesh, so the contrast is a canonical single geometric parameter rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The complete exact profile proves strict maximization by uniform spacing and sharp limiting improvement under severe imbalance; this gives an exact finite-element orthogonal-projection stability benchmark and complements known infinite-period and uniform-spacing results.
